summary: Research specification and deterministic Python transformation of supplied JSON records into an evidence-bound continuity profile: verified participation, known pauses, unexplained gaps, events and separate lineages. Source v1.0.0, English academic edition academic-pdf-2; real-subject and evaluator qualification remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.

execution_boundary.input: Caller-supplied ci-profile-input/v1 JSON with declared time axis, witnesses, intervals, pauses, events, lineages, uncertainty and claim ceiling.
execution_boundary.output: Deterministic continuity profile, formation_depth_vector and digest of that vector only.

related_works.title: Temporal AI Presence Profile v1.0
related_works.role: Defines sustained bounded AI participation across time; CI supplies a proposed evidence-description and measurement layer.

related_works.title: Beacon Profile v0.1
related_works.role: Addresses recognition and continuity-related presentation; a CI profile does not implement or certify Beacon conformance.

related_works.title: C-Calculus / Governed Binding Stack v0.1
related_works.role: Provides governed binding and transition context. CI records supplied lineage and event distinctions; it does not perform the governed binding.

related_works.title: Personality Formation and Time-Shaped Continuity
related_works.role: Studies formation over time; CI distinguishes covered participation from unsupported elapsed time without measuring personality or maturity.

related_works.title: Theoretical Core of Project Ester
related_works.role: Supplies the wider conceptual architecture. CI is one bounded research instrument within that context.

related_works.title: Entity vs. Profile
related_works.role: Separates a persistent entity claim from a reproducible profile. A computed CI profile cannot settle that distinction by itself.
